title: 梅西百货业绩指引不及预期 市场关注消费需求变化
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: How's he feeling? I mean, he was doing so well and the market was rewarding him and suddenly this massive selloff.
segments.zh: 他感觉如何？之前表现很好，市场也给予回报，突然就出现大规模抛售。

segments.en: Yeah, and what's interesting? I mean, it's only about a 2% selloff but we talk about this idea of a company that it put in basically what is now six straight quarters of Comp Sales Growth,
segments.zh: 是的，有趣的是，这只有约2%的抛售，但我们讨论的是这家公司已连续六个季度实现同店销售增长，

segments.en: which is a huge turnaround for a company that had been struggling. The concern amongst investors was you take a look at Q1 and Q2 and then if you look at the guidance
segments.zh: 对一家曾陷入困境的公司来说，这是巨大的转变。市场参与者的担忧在于，看一季度和二季度，再看他们给出的

segments.en: that they gave for Q3, there clearly does seem to be some sort of deceleration in that growth.
segments.zh: 三季度指引，增长似乎确实出现某种放缓。

segments.en: Now I did have a chance to speak with Tony Spring this morning on the phone and he pushed back on that idea.
segments.zh: 今早我有机会与Tony Spring通电话，他反驳了这一观点。

segments.en: He basically said, I don't know if you could throw the quote up, but in his view on a stacked basis, there is no deceleration.
segments.zh: 他基本上说，不知道能否引用原话，但在他看来，按累积基础计算，并没有放缓。

segments.en: He thinks there actually is a bit more of an acceleration going into that but I think the way he measures those numbers internally, a little bit different than the standards
segments.zh: 他认为实际上有更多加速，但我认为他内部衡量这些数字的方式，与彭博社的标准略有不同，

segments.en: that we have here at Bloomberg and a little bit different than the standards of some folks in Wall Street have in assess.
segments.zh: 也与华尔街一些人士评估的标准略有不同。

segments.en: Well, I mean, you can crush expectations internally but you have to deliver to the street at the end of the day but you mentioned kind of this turnaround story really gaining traction.
segments.zh: 嗯，你可以内部超越预期，但最终必须向市场兑现。你提到这个转变故事真正获得动力。

segments.en: What does the kind of rest of the year look like? Again, if we're kind of worried about the state of the US consumer, state of global consumer?
segments.zh: 今年剩余时间会怎样？如果我们担心美国消费者和全球消费者的状况？

segments.en: Well, I mean, he made it clear that the guidance does reflect the uncertainty in the macroeconomic uncertainties specifically gas prices.
segments.zh: 他明确表示，业绩指引确实反映了宏观不确定性，尤其是油价。

segments.en: He said the tariff issue was a little bit more stable. Obviously tariffs are still high but they're the volatility that was associated with the tariff situation a year ago.
segments.zh: 他说关税问题已相对稳定。关税仍高，但已不像一年前那样波动剧烈。

segments.en: He said that smoothed out a lot. He keeps saying that the consumer is resilient.
segments.zh: 他说情况已平稳许多。他反复强调消费者仍具韧性。

segments.en: However, I should point out, when you look at their results, I mean, this is still a company being driven by the more luxury Bloomingdale's brand.
segments.zh: 不过，我要指出，看他们的业绩，这仍是一家靠高端品牌Bloomingdale's驱动的公司。
